body.statement: Suppose the strongly connected component of \(Y\) in \(\mathcal S\) is the singleton \(\{Y\}\) and no summary bidirected edge joins \(Y\) to a directed ancestor of \(Y\). Then every \((G,\mathcal M)\in\mathfrak F(\mathcal S,L,H,p)\) satisfies \(q(\mathcal M)=A_{\mathrm{FA}}(p)\), and \(\Theta(\mathcal S,L,H,p)=\{A_{\mathrm{FA}}(p)\}\) with \(\underline q(p)=\overline q(p)=A_{\mathrm{FA}}(p)\). This is exactly the Ferreira--Assaad controlled-micro-direct-effect adjustment formula after deleting their instantaneous possible parents under the maintained positive-lag convention.
body.justification: A sharp envelope must recover the published point-identification functional on the part of the summary-graph model where common adjustment is valid.
body.gap: FerreiraAssaad2026 proves the adjustment formula under these sufficient graphical conditions; the new content is its exact embedding as the singleton face of a sharp refinement-union envelope.
body.consumer: Applied users can run one procedure that returns the familiar adjustment estimand when justified and honest bounds otherwise.
